releasePolicy: One full release only. No public partial bank or empty navigation entry.
selectionClaim: Editorial selection for practical learning. Word-frequency evidence supports vocabulary selection, not a statistical ranking of whole sentences.
levelClaim: Approximate practice bands. Not official CEFR sentence certification or an exam syllabus.
reviewClaim: Editorial checks are recorded per entry. No native-language review is claimed without actual sign-off.
sourcePolicy: Original teaching examples preferred. Third-party sentence text needs exact author, sentence ID, license, source URL and modification record. Goethe examples must not be bulk copied. Frequency diagnostics are local QA only and are not redistributed as part of the original sentence text.
audioPolicy: Reuse exact existing audio when available; otherwise free compatible German browser speech. Playback can be unavailable. No paid generation, new account pooling or claim of 7000 human recordings.
storagePolicy: Server-account preferences and completed activities. Guests remain volatile tab-only. No localStorage, sessionStorage or IndexedDB.

sources.title: Tatoeba reuse and learner-material guidance
sources.use: Potential attributed sentence source only after personal proofreading. Not used as a bulk imported sentence bank in the initial original working set. Audio licensing is separate and must be checked per contributor/file.

editorialRelease.method: Every selected row reread for German grammar, Egyptian Arabic and English meaning, standalone context and approximate difficulty; final exact and near-duplicate checks. Engineering tests are separate.
